menu_options.cloud: Old MagicAir cloud (api2) — until Tion shuts it down

cloud_v4.title: Tion cloud
cloud_v4.description:
Sign in with the account of the new Tion MagicAir app. Home Assistant opens a captcha page, then Tion e-mails you a code.

Tion currently accepts the captcha only from a page at http://localhost. To sign in, forward port 80 of this computer to Home Assistant for the duration of the login and enter http://localhost below — see the [guide]({docs_url}). Signing in from a phone will not work.

data_description.password: Only used to sign in, not stored.
data_description.captcha_base_url: Leave empty if you did not set up port forwarding. Otherwise enter http://localhost.

cloud.title: Tion
cloud.description: Credentials of the old MagicAir cloud (api2.magicair.tion.ru). Tion is shutting it down: if the account is already moved to the new Tion MagicAir app, choose “Tion cloud”.

ble.title: Tion 4S over Bluetooth
ble.description: Breezers seen by Home Assistant Bluetooth adapters and ESPHome proxies: {found}. If the list is empty, enter the MAC address manually. A breezer bound to MagicAir does not advertise — unbind it or switch MagicAir off first.

ble_pair.title: Pairing {name}
ble_pair.description: Put {name} ({address}) into pairing mode: in standby (yellow LED) hold the power button for about 5 seconds until the LED blinks blue. Then press Submit within ~30 seconds. A Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy must be within a few metres of the breezer.

captcha.title: Captcha
captcha.description: Complete the check on the page that opened. Home Assistant continues once it is done.

code.title: E-mail code
code.description: Tion sent a confirmation code to {email}. Enter it to finish signing in.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Tion again
reauth_confirm.description:
Sign in to Tion again for {email}: the cloud rejected the saved session or has not renewed it for over an hour (then it is most likely a Tion outage and the request clears itself). Enter the password, then the captcha and the e-mail code follow.

The captcha is only accepted from a page at http://localhost — see the [guide]({docs_url}).

data_description.captcha_base_url: Leave empty if you did not set up port forwarding. Otherwise enter http://localhost.

reauth_legacy.title: Move to the new Tion cloud
reauth_legacy.description:
The {email} entry uses the old MagicAir cloud, which Tion is shutting down (or it already refused the login). Sign in to the new Tion cloud: password, then captcha and e-mail code. Devices, entity IDs and history are kept — they are matched by MAC address.

Move the account in the new Tion MagicAir app first. The captcha is only accepted from a page at http://localhost — see the [guide]({docs_url}).

data_description.captcha_base_url: Leave empty if you did not set up port forwarding. Otherwise enter http://localhost.

error.client_rejected: Cloud rejected client_id/secret — Tion updated their mobile app. Capture fresh credentials (see tools/debug_auth.py).
error.grant_deprecated: Tion disabled password-grant (unsupported_grant_type). Auth must be migrated to OAuth code-flow with PKCE.
error.endpoint_gone: Endpoint api2.magicair.tion.ru is gone (404/410). Cloud moved to a new domain — check HA logs.
error.captcha: Cloud returned HTML (likely Cloudflare/captcha). Your IP may be blocked.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Tion cloud. Check internet access and DNS.
error.unknown: Authentication failed for an unknown reason. See HA logs (enable DEBUG for custom_components.tion).
error.invalid_address: MAC address must look like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.ble_not_found: The breezer is not visible to any Bluetooth adapter or proxy of Home Assistant.
error.ble_pair_failed: Pairing failed. Make sure the LED blinks blue and nothing else (MagicAir, phone app) is connected, then try again.
error.ble_not_4s: The device answered, but it is not a Tion 4S.
error.invalid_captcha: Tion did not accept the captcha from this page. It currently accepts it only from a page at http://localhost: set up port forwarding as the guide describes and enter http://localhost as the captcha page address.
error.invalid_captcha_url: Enter an address like http://localhost or https://host:port, without a path.
error.code_expired: The code has expired. Submit the form again to get a new one.

abort.already_configured: This account or breezer is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: Signing in to this account is already in progress.
abort.legacy_configured: This account is already set up through the old MagicAir cloud. Move it to the new cloud in the entry's options (“Move to the new Tion cloud”) — this keeps entity IDs and history.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in to Tion, the integration has reconnected.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in to a different Tion account than the configured one.
abort.password_not_set: This Tion account has no permanent password. Set one in the Tion MagicAir app and try again.

data.migrate_v4: Move to the new Tion cloud (password, captcha and e-mail code)

account_not_migrated.title: Tion account not moved to the new cloud
account_not_migrated.description: The Tion account {email} is not moved to the new cloud yet. Move it in the Tion MagicAir app, then reload the integration.
